title: VARG: Value-Aware and Ranking-Aligned Generative Retrieval for Dynamic E-commerce Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.14493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Integrating recall and pre-ranking in e-commerce search requires candidate generation to account for relevance, personalization, and business value before final ranking. To this end, we present VARG, a generative retrieval system for Tmall App search that directly admits generated item candidates to the existing final ranker. VARG-ID constructs semantic prefixes using RQ-VAE, enhances search relevance through bidirectional query-item contrastive learning, and combines these prefixes with a value-ordered third token to provide fine-grained item addresses and a business-value prior. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning progressively learns item-to-identifier mappings, query-semantic retrieval, and personalized retrieval. Personalized model training combines value-aware and hierarchy-aligned supervision with expanded user context, and uses local ordinal supervision (LO-SFT) to learn the local within-cluster ordering encoded by the third token

translated_title: VARG：面向动态电商搜索的价值感知与排序对齐生成式检索
translated_abstract: 在电商搜索中，将召回与预排序整合起来，要求候选生成在进入最终排序之前就能兼顾相关性、个性化和业务价值。为此，我们提出了VARG，一个面向天猫App搜索的生成式检索系统，它可以将生成的商品候选直接送入现有的最终排序器。VARG-ID利用RQ-VAE构建语义前缀，通过双向查询-商品对比学习增强搜索相关性，并将这些前缀与按价值排序的第三个token相结合，从而提供细粒度的商品地址和业务价值先验。三阶段监督微调逐步学习商品到标识符的映射、查询语义检索以及个性化检索。个性化模型训练将价值感知与层级对齐的监督同扩展的用户上下文相结合，并使用局部序数监督（LO-SFT）来学习由第三个token编码的簇内局部排序。
tldr: 提出了天猫搜索生成式检索系统VARG，通过RQ-VAE语义前缀与价值排序token构建商品标识符，并结合三阶段监督微调，实现价值感知、个性化的候选生成并直接对接现有最终排序器。
en_tdlr: VARG is a generative retrieval system for Tmall search that builds item identifiers from RQ-VAE semantic prefixes plus a value-ordered token, and employs three-stage supervised fine-tuning to generate value-aware, personalized candidates directly admitted to the existing final ranker.
